name: TensorPM v1.41.2
body:
# Changelog - v1.41.2

This update brings web search to every plan, fits the project metrics card to every column width,
and shows the general category under its proper name.

## 🎉 New Features

- **Web search on every plan:** you can now store your own Brave Search API key on Trial and Pro
  too, not only on Business. Open Settings → AI → Web Search, paste the key, and the project agent
  can search the web for you. Your own keys for AI providers remain a Business feature.
- **Project metrics that fit any width:** the metrics card in Pulse (status, budget, effort) now
  picks its layout from the space it actually has. Wide cards show three columns with a summary
  above each chart. Medium cards show three compact columns with the headline figure on top.
  Narrow columns show one metric per row, with the ring next to its figures. All rings in a card
  have the same size, and legends are no longer cut off.
- **Short budget figures in compact tiles:** large amounts read "736K EUR" instead of
  "736,000.00 EUR", so they fit the tile. Hover over the tile to see the full amounts.
- **The project agent names the missing setup step:** when web search, a mailbox or a calendar is
  not set up for a project, the project agent now tells you what to set up and where (a Brave
  Search API key or Browser Use under Settings → AI, a mailbox or calendar assigned to the project
  under Connectors) instead of saying it has no internet access.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **The general category has a readable name:** every project keeps a general category for items
  without a category. It was shown under its internal name "general", also in German. It now reads
  "General" in English and "Allgemein" in German: in the list, on Kanban and priority cards, in
  the category picker, the context menu, recurring items and the action item picker.
- **No empty "general" group above your own categories:** after the first save of a project that
  brings its own categories, an empty "general" group appeared at the top of the list. The list
  now leaves it out while it holds no items and no subcategories. It shows up again as soon as it
  holds something, in edit mode, and whenever it is the only category.
- **Pie/Bar switch stays inside narrow metric cards:** in a narrow card the switch moves to its own
  line instead of running past the card edge.

## 🏗️ Improvements

- Tooltips in the narrowest metrics layout use their full width, so words are no longer broken
  in the middle.
- Budget figures in compact tiles that are too small to abbreviate show whole units (in German
  "74.213 EUR" instead of "74.213,4 EUR").
- Dependency maintenance updates.

---

## 📅 Release Info

- **Version**: 1.41.2
- **Release Date**: 2026-10-01
- **Previous Version**: 1.41.1
- **Type**: Patch Release
